description: Source code implementing CUDA-based distribution functions for PyTorch, including Poisson, Binomial, Gamma, and Dirichlet distributions, with kernel launches and tensor operations.

methods.name: _s_poisson_cuda
methods.description: Computes Poisson distribution samples on CUDA given lambda tensor and optional generator.

methods.name: _s_binomial_cuda
methods.description: Computes Binomial distribution samples on CUDA given count, probability tensors, and optional generator.

methods.name: _s_gamma_cuda
methods.description: Computes Gamma distribution samples on CUDA given alpha tensor and optional generator.

methods.name: _s_dirichlet_cuda
methods.description: Computes Dirichlet distribution samples on CUDA given alpha tensor and optional generator.

methods.name: _standard_gamma_grad_cuda
methods.description: Calculates gradient of standard gamma distribution on CUDA given input tensors.

methods.name: _dirichlet_grad_cuda
methods.description: Calculates gradient of Dirichlet distribution on CUDA given input tensors.
